text: Unauthorized privileged access can indicate privilege escalation or misuse of administrative credentials. Investigate which account elevated, from which host, and whether the elevation matches an approved change.
title: Unauthorized privileged access

text: Valid Accounts is a MITRE ATT&CK technique involving the use of legitimate credentials to gain access. Adversaries reuse stolen credentials so their activity blends in with normal authentication traffic.
title: Valid Accounts

text: Normal authentication events do not necessarily indicate malicious activity. A single successful login from a known host and a usual time window is expected behaviour and should not be escalated on its own.
title: Baseline authentication behaviour

text: Brute Force covers repeated authentication attempts against one or many accounts. A burst of failures from a single source IP followed by a success is a strong indicator of a successful password guessing attack.
title: Brute Force

text: Outbound traffic to a known command and control server suggests an already compromised host. Isolate the host and review what was transferred before the connection was observed.
title: Command and control traffic

text: Windows User Account Control bypasses let a process run with elevated integrity without prompting the user. Look for auto-elevating binaries and unusual parent-child process chains.
title: UAC bypass
